before: A synthesized stand-in face did not count as measurable for layout, a host face for one face of a family with its own bytes painted in the family's own face, the PDF converter counted its own same-family stand-ins as coverage, and an English family name did not find faces supplied under its localized name.
after: Layout measures stand-in faces with real metrics, paint uses the face that measurement uses, the converter reports same-family stand-ins as partial coverage, and the localized name lookup works in both directions.
reason: The change is in local font resolution, measurement, paint aliases, and export reports only. Shared state, operations, and synchronization are unchanged.
